messages:
Maya: Heads up — planning a small quiet launch for route /v2/predict at 14:00 UTC (~30m from now). Canary will be 0.5% traffic for 10m then ramp if smoke is clean. Need quick signoffs and rollback readiness. Checklist: 1) canary toggle flag ready, 2) smoke runbook assigned, 3) rollback toggle tested locally, 4) alert paging set. Please ack and call out any blockers.
Jules: Ack. I'll own the toggle and rollout policy. I'll be on until +1h post-ramp.
Sam: Ack from infra side. I validated the canary pool has capacity and autoscale profiles look good.
Vic: I'll watch latency dashboards and take first responder if something spikes. Can someone drop the smoke steps?
Maya: @Vic, thanks. Alice will run the smoke. Smoke steps (short): 1) run quick perf probe against canary, 2) run functional traces via smoke suite, 3) check token-cost regression dashboard. If any check fails: flip canary -> baseline and notify.
Alice: On it. Smoke commands I run from my workstation:
```
# perf probe
ab -n 500 -c 10 https://api.redwood.example/v2/predict?route=test-canary

# smoke functional
python tests/smoke/run_smoke.py --route /v2/predict --env prod --canary
```
Will report back in ~5m once preflight is done.
Jules: Toggle is staged in the console under Release > Toggles > v2-predict-canary. I tested the flag flip in staging. Rollback toggle name: v2-predict-fallback. Confirmed it instantly moves traffic back to baseline.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: #4567 — quiet-launch /v2/predict canary. Linked PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1823. CI: all checks passed.
Sam: Small note — there's a transient mem growth in one host in the canary pool last night, I patched yesterday but I'll keep an eye during ramp. If it reappears, I'll drain the host and notify.
Maya: Thanks. Quick ask: anyone not available for rollback within next 45m? We need at least one toggle owner + infra + oncall.
Vic: Available.
Jules: Available.
Alice: Available, will run smoke and post results.
Maya: Great — proceeding with canary flip at T+30 (14:00 UTC). I'll post here when I flip. If you see anything unusual, ping @pager immediately and drop results here. :thumbsup:
